name: Rajnish Wellness Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Mumbai-based Rajnish Wellness Limited is a company engaged in the business of selling various products in categories ranging from consumer durables to ayurvedic personal care products. The Company's major focus area is sexual wellness, energy revitalization, and personal care products.[1]
keyPoints: History[1] Rajnish Wellness is the extension and expansion of Rajnish Hot Deal Pvt Ltd. Co. started as a small teleshopping venture with the name- Quick Service (QS) Advertising in 2009 and has grown into a brand in ayurvedic product industry dedicated to people’s personal and sexual wellness.
